about: Each session's run of show, rebuilt on November 18, 2026 at Ben's request on the routine in docs/teaching/leading-a-session.md: your plans from last week, try each app, write your next round, your questions. `lengths.60` is the 60-minute session in one call that most cohorts run and what a new cohort gets by default; `scenes` is the 75-minute session for a cohort of eight or more, trying apps in groups of three. Week 0 is Prep and week 1 is finding the problem, so their middle parts hear each problem rather than try each app; week 5 is the showing. The site seeds a new cohort's sessions from this file, and every scene stays editable in the class builder; the leader writes each person's name, plan, and app into the slides before the session. Scenes use the site's shape (assets/show-lib.js on the site branch): kind, title, minutes, body (what the main stage shows, four short lines at most), and config. A scene's `note` is for the leader only, and a week's `questions` go into the cohort's question bank. Awaiting Ben's review.

weeks.title: Cohort Prep: getting set up and meeting your group
weeks.question: What do I need in order to build at all?

scenes.title: Arrive
scenes.body: Your name, where you are joining from, and one thing in your life you wish worked differently. That last line is the first entry in the log you start tonight.

scenes.title: How we talk to one another
scenes.body: The four rules, said aloud: no correcting what does not matter, no acting surprised, no taking over, and no small digs at who someone is. When one is broken, someone says so plainly, the person says thanks, and we move on.

scenes.title: Open each app
scenes.body: In your group's room, each person shows their app's address, or where setup stopped, and the group works through it.

config.prompt: Show your app's address, or where setup stopped.

scenes.note: Visit each room; bring anyone still stuck back to the main room.

scenes.title: What a build looks like
scenes.body: Every session from week 1 opens with each person showing the week's work on a device. Here is a strong build and a weak one, side by side. Then everyone practices the three questions on the weak one: where is it going, how is it going, and what is next.

scenes.title: Start your noticing log
scenes.body: For five days, write one line whenever one of these happens: I wished something worked differently. I gave up on something I care about. I did something the long way because nothing helped. Someone I know struggled with the same thing. No app ideas yet, just what happened. Write today's line now, before you leave: this log is where week 1's problem comes from.

config.prompt: What is one thing that happened today that could go in your log?

scenes.title: Your questions
scenes.body: Only your leaders read the answers.

config.prompt: What questions do you still have?

scenes.note: Answer two or three aloud and the rest before the next session, and open the next session with what you read.

questions.prompt: What do you hope your app will do for someone?
How ready do you feel to build?

Tell me about the last time you ___
